description: This file contains generated C# source code defining classes, methods, and configurations related to Azure Storage and Queue integrations within the Orleans framework. It includes classes for managing Azure queues, blob lease options, stream providers, lease providers, and related configurations, as well as data adapters for Azure queues and storage operations.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManager
classes.description: Manages Azure Storage Queue operations such as adding, clearing, deleting, and retrieving messages.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Blob Lease Provider, including container name and BlobServiceClient.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator for AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions to ensure configuration correctness.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Queue including queue names, message timeout, and service client.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator for AzureQueueOptions to ensure proper setup.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create Azure Queue adapters for Orleans streams, managing queue connections and message handling.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
classes.description: Data adapter for Azure Queue, serializing and deserializing batch containers for V1 format.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
classes.description: Data adapter for Azure Queue, serializing and deserializing batch containers for V2 format.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: Handles stream delivery failures with Azure Table Storage, including failure entity management.

classes.name: StreamDeliveryFailureEntity
classes.description: Represents a failure entity stored in Azure Table Storage for stream delivery failures.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Options for Azure Storage operations, including table and storage client configurations.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Policy options for Azure Storage, including timeouts and retry counts.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator for Azure Storage operation options, ensuring correct configuration.

classes.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures Orleans Silo to use Azure Queue Streams.

classes.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures Orleans Cluster Client for Azure Queue Streams.

methods.name: AddQueueMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the Azure Storage Queue.

methods.name: ClearQueue
methods.description: Clears all messages in the queue.

methods.name: DeleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes the entire Azure Storage Queue.

methods.name: GetQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message from the queue.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes or creates the queue if it doesn't exist.

methods.description: Generates a default partition key based on stream provider name and deployment ID.
